Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Omnibus 3 Note">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 3]]'' places the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade|''Masquerade'']] story arc of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron]]'' around a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Thus, ''Masquerade'' must take place around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> a '''funeral''' was held for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] member [[Ibtisam]] following her [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Evacuation of Ciutric|rescue]] of [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron 35">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
